title: Chief Accountant

Direct mentorship from department director
16 days annual leave, above market standard
responsibilities: Lead the executive agenda around core accounting activities aligned with company goals and standards.

Champion company-wide transformation in day-to-day operations related to the role and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Define the long-term strategy for reporting and performance tracking to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Champion company-wide transformation in collaboration with cross-functional departments, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Define the long-term strategy for a team of professionals, setting clear goals and supporting their development.
requirements: 12+ years of experience with C-level or executive leadership exposure relevant to the Chief Accountant role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Strong time-management and prioritization skills
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

benefits.label: Premium healthcare package for employee and dependents
16-18 days of paid annual leave
Free lunch, coffee and snacks at the office
Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Clear career development and promotion path
13th month salary and performance bonus

Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Team player with a collaborative working style
Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Team player with a collaborative working style
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Training budget and certification sponsorship

Laptop and equipment provided
